models.name: AssemblyAI: Universal-3.5 Pro
models.languageDetails: Native code-switching across 18 languages. The synchronous API supports clips up to 120 seconds; Drift chunks longer recordings.
models.ratingNote: Accuracy and native mixed-language recognition are the main strengths. Comparable latency is unverified.

models.name: Microsoft AI: MAI-Transcribe 2
models.languageDetails: Automatic language identification and mixed-language speech. Provider reports a strong FLEURS benchmark result; not a Drift benchmark.
models.ratingNote: High reported multilingual accuracy; faster than the previous MAI generation.

models.name: OpenAI: GPT Transcribe
models.languageDetails: Supports multiple language hints and mixed-language speech. See model documentation for coverage.
models.ratingNote: 3.3% word error rate and 42× real-time speed on the Artificial Analysis speech-to-text benchmark (October 2026).

models.name: Microsoft AI: MAI-Transcribe 1.5
models.languageDetails: Automatic language identification across 43 languages; accents and noisy audio are a stated focus.
models.ratingNote: Accuracy-oriented multilingual model; older MAI generation.

models.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o Mini Transcribe
models.languageDetails: Multilingual; language accuracy varies. Check provider language coverage for your language.
models.ratingNote: Smaller transcription model with an accuracy/cost tradeoff. Comparable latency and minute cost are unverified.

models.name: OpenAI: Whisper 1
models.languageDetails: Multilingual transcription; includes English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese and many others.
models.ratingNote: Established multilingual baseline; newer accuracy-focused models are available.

models.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o Transcribe
models.languageDetails: Multilingual; includes English, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese and other supported speech languages.
models.ratingNote: Provider reports improved recognition over Whisper. Comparable OpenRouter latency and minute cost are unverified.
